name: Shropshire (United Kingdom)
description: A gold field strewn with black ermine spots, bearing two blue piles from the top edge; three gold-and-blue leopard faces ('loggerheads') are arranged two on the piles, one between.
history: Registered with the Flag Institute in 2012, based on the loggerheads device borne for Shropshire since the Middle Ages.

features.role: two blue piles from the chief

features.symbolism: the three loggerheads are Shropshire's ancient emblem
